summary: A medical dispenser kiosk (heal station) for shooters and arcade games: a 0.7 x 1.78 m white chamfered cabine… joints charge, flap; options mount, cross, fluid; sockets socket_dispense, socket_light.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.health_station or place "prefab": "health_station" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
